arguments.script: var current=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene();if(current.isDirty)throw new System.Exception("Preserving unsaved scene");var scene=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scenes/Level05_Cave.unity");var m=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().Single(t=>t.name.StartsWith("Jump King"));var p=UnityEngine.JsonUtility.FromJson<InstallJumpKingFifth.Plan>(System.IO.File.ReadAllText("scripts/jk-original-20261111/plan.json"));var expected=p.cells.ToDictionary(c=>new UnityEngine.Vector3Int(c.x,c.y,0),c=>c.kind);int mismatch=0,count=0;foreach(var pos in m.cellBounds.allPositionsWithin){var tile=m.GetTile(pos);if(tile)count++;if(expected.TryGetValue(pos,out int k)){string wanted=k==0?"Terrain.asset":"Slope"+k+".asset";if(k==0){if(tile==null||m.GetColliderType(pos)!=UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tile.ColliderType.Grid)mismatch++;}else if(!UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(tile).EndsWith(wanted))mismatch++;}else if(tile)mismatch++;}var level=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<CampaignLevel>();var all=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<CampaignInteractable>();System.IO.File.WriteAllText("scripts/jk-original-20261111/reopened.txt","Saved scene reopened; tiles="+count+"; source differences="+mismatch+"; collectible objects="+all.Count(t=>t.kind==CampaignInteractable.Kind.Star)+"; checkpoints="+all.Count(t=>t.kind==CampaignInteractable.Kind.Checkpoint)+"; finish flags="+all.Count(t=>t.kind==CampaignInteractable.Kind.Door)+"; spawn="+level.initialSpawn);if(mismatch!=0||count!=7565)throw new System.Exception("Saved original map mismatch");UnityEditor.Selection.activeGameObject=m.gameObject;var v=UnityEditor.SceneView.lastActiveSceneView;v.in2DMode=true;v.LookAt(new UnityEngine.Vector3(12,5,0),UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity,10,true,true);v.Focus();v.Repaint();
